content: 0 of 7 .csproj projects in pmcro-runtime have tests. The staged .pmcro/skills-staging/dotnet-test pack is 21 sub-skills of generic agent-md scaffolding, not a quick win to install wholesale. Instead: pick one real, dependency-free, high-value class (Loop/TerminalCommandPolicy.cs, the EC-AUTOAPPROVE-TERM-001 command classifier) and write real xUnit v3 tests against it, verified by an actual dotnet test run.
success_criteria: Scaffold a test project matching the already-pinned central package (xunit.v3.mtp-v2), not the classic xunit template
Cover all three Classification outcomes (AutoReadOnly, AutoMutating, RequiresHil)
Explicitly test the denylist-overrides-allowlist guarantee stated in the file's own header comment
dotnet test must actually pass, verified by real process output, zero warnings
bounds: read-only against everything except the new test project and .slnx registration
